_comment: Source catalogue (i18n-l10n.md §3). ICU MessageFormat, keys hierarchical and semantic. English is the source language; every other locale is translated from this file. The backend never emits these sentences - it emits the key plus params, and the client renders them.
errors.malformed_request: The request could not be read.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed this entry in the meantime.
errors.gone: This entry has been permanently deleted.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a moment.
errors.dependency_unavailable: A required service is temporarily unavailable.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Reference: {request_id}
config.db_dsn_missing: {variable} is not set. Hubtask needs a PostgreSQL connection.
config.secret_key_missing: {variable} is not set. Without it, stored credentials cannot be encrypted.
config.secret_key_too_short: {variable} must be at least {minimum} characters long.
config.secret_file_unreadable: {variable} points to a file that cannot be read.
config.tenancy_invalid: {variable} must be either single or multi.
config.roles_empty: {variable} names no role. At least one of api, worker, scheduler, automation is required.
config.log_format_invalid: {variable} must be either json or text.
config.log_level_invalid: {variable} must be one of debug, info, warn, error.
config.db_pool_invalid: {variable} is outside the valid range. The minimum pool size cannot exceed the maximum.
config.duration_invalid: {variable} must be a duration such as 30s, 5m or 1h30m.
config.rate_limit_invalid: {variable} must be at least 1. Zero would block every request.
config.storage_kind_invalid: {variable} must be either local or s3.
config.storage_path_missing: {variable} is not set, although local storage is configured.
config.s3_incomplete: {variable} is missing. Object storage needs a bucket and credentials.
config.smtp_port_invalid: {variable} must be a port between 1 and 65535.
config.smtp_from_missing: {variable} is not set, although an SMTP server is configured.
config.smtp_security_invalid: {variable} must be one of starttls, tls, none.
config.tracing_endpoint_missing: {variable} is not set, although tracing is enabled. Spans would be built and discarded.
config.locale_invalid: {variable} must be a BCP 47 language tag such as en, de-AT or pt-BR.
config.timezone_unknown: {variable} must be an IANA time zone such as Europe/Berlin. {value} is not one.
config.backup_not_configured: No backup target is configured. A restore drill is a release criterion.
config.smtp_missing: No SMTP server is configured. Notifications by email are unavailable.
config.base_url_missing: HUBTASK_BASE_URL is not set. Links in emails and feeds will be wrong.
config.oidc_missing_in_multi_tenancy: Multi-tenant operation without an OIDC issuer. Only personal access tokens will work.
config.smtp_without_tls: SMTP to {host} is configured without TLS. Credentials travel unencrypted.
dependency.unavailable: A service this feature needs cannot be reached at the moment. Everything else keeps working.
dependency.timeout: {dependency} did not answer in time. Please try again in a moment.
dependency.circuit_open: {dependency} is unreachable at the moment. Hubtask has stopped calling it and will try again shortly.
